title: Tamia Line Dance Tutorial - "Can't Get Enough"

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor breaks the line dance down into numbered sections and teaches step-by-step facing away from the camera. He offers tips on spatial awareness by referencing physical objects in the room to help students with turns.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to the Tamia line dance tutorial
Breaking down section 4 and quarter turn technique
Slow review of all sections together

common_mistakes: People get messed up on section 2 footwork
People get confused on the turn in section 4

steps_taught.name: Section 2 weave
steps_taught.description: Crossing right over left, stepping back and side, then left over right

steps_taught.name: Section 3 steps
steps_taught.description: Stepping out with right leg, back on left, cross with right

steps_taught.name: Section 4 turn
steps_taught.description: Step out and quarter turn using shoulder orientation

what_works: Dividing the dance into four distinct sections
Using room landmarks like cabinets and doors for turn orientation
what_hinders: The teacher only demonstrates facing away from the camera

quotes.text: I divided this up into four easy sections.
This is where people get messed up.
Listen to the way I'm saying it, it's gonna help you be right on top of it.
This is where people get confused on the turn.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor demonstrates section 1 counts while facing away from the camera
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact weight distribution on the floor

extraction.distinctive_method: Instructing students to use room landmarks (like a cabinet or door aligned with their shoulder) to anchor their quarter turns.
